edit.description.md: Create banner.svg at the repo root as a direct reflection of the Aether Grid console UI (Hex-Lab default skin: one continuous surface, Declination hex backdrop, Loom-9 cables, KV grid, GPU block, hairline Scope edges), and add it to the README.md header as the main project banner. Branch was rebased onto aether-live after #8 landed mid-flight, so the PR head is DPG1QNP-banner-v2; the original DPG1QNP-banner branch is stale and can be deleted once #10 merges.
